title: Financials (Akaunting)
description: Reads Akaunting's MariaDB directly (MySQL-Akaunting datasource) rather than its API, to sidestep the dual Host+X-Company header quirk documented in important.md #2 -- this is a pure read-only reporting path.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(opening_balance),0) FROM ak_accounts WHERE company_id = 1) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'income' THEN amount WHEN type = 'expense' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END),0) FROM ak_transactions WHERE company_id = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS cash_balance
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) / 30.0 AS burn_rate_per_day FROM ak_transactions WHERE company_id = 1 AND type = 'expense' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND paid_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

SELECT cash_balance / NULLIF(burn_rate_per_day, 0) AS runway_days FROM (SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(opening_balance),0) FROM ak_accounts WHERE company_id = 1) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'income' THEN amount WHEN type = 'expense' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END),0) FROM ak_transactions WHERE company_id = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS cash_balance, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) / 30.0 FROM ak_transactions WHERE company_id = 1 AND type = 'expense' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND paid_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS burn_rate_per_day) t
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount),0) AS payroll_total FROM ak_transactions t JOIN ak_categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.company_id = 1 AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.name = 'Payroll Expense'

panels.title: Income vs Expense Transactions Over Time

targets.rawSql: SELECT paid_at AS time, amount AS income, NULL AS expense FROM ak_transactions WHERE company_id = 1 AND type = 'income' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(paid_at) UNION ALL SELECT paid_at AS time, NULL AS income, amount AS expense FROM ak_transactions WHERE company_id = 1 AND type = 'expense' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(paid_at) ORDER BY time

SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) AS total FROM ak_transactions t JOIN ak_categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.company_id = 1 AND t.type = 'expense' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total DESC
